source: src/lib/generated/moveScripts.json (Layer 1 union scripts, PR #168) + src/lib/moves.ts (36 game moves)
method: Match requires same script type (particle) AND same script category (motion class) AND same timing family (single-hit damage / damage_with_status status puff / multi_hit beats / two_turn charge). Within damage family, the script effect string is decomp provenance, not an executed step: damage-family steps are projectile/lunge + impact only, so an effect-name difference with no step difference does not block a match and is noted per entry. For damage_with_status games the status puff must match the game secondary status. Power proximity breaks ties; decomp accuracy (decomp_black2_moves.json) breaks ties where noted. No game move data, category, effect, or learnset was changed or invented; this file routes game move ids to existing scripts only. Exact-id game moves (10) are NOT listed here: they resolve directly from moveScripts.json and take precedence in getMoveScript(). IRON_BARRAGE correction 2026-10-26 (Mars decision): effect NONE -> MULTI_HIT in src/lib/moves.ts (description 'Fires 2-5 iron shards' unchanged); IRON_BARRAGE now maps to GEAR_GRIND below, so the matched total is 36/36.

qualityDefs.exact: Type, category, timing family, and mapped effect all match, and power is equal (name-normalization entries included).
qualityDefs.fit: Type, category, and timing family match and power is within 15, but the script effect string differs in provenance only (no step difference), or a name-normalized script is within 5 power.

AQUA_SHOT.basis: Same type/category, exact power 40, plain HIT, special_projectile. Game 'small ball of water' = Water Gun presentation.

AQUA_CANNON.basis: Same type/category, family damage, power 90 vs 95 (delta 5), accuracy 100 matches decomp SURF accuracy 100 (MUDDY_WATER is 85). Script effect DOUBLE_DAMAGE_DIVE is provenance only: damage-family steps are projectile+impact with no extra beat.

HYDRO_SURGE.basis: Same type/category, exact power 120, exact accuracy 80 (decomp), plain HIT, special_projectile with power>=120 camera shake appropriate to a 120-power move.

EMBER_TOSS.basis: Same type/category, exact power 40, BURN_HIT with burn status puff matching game BURN 10%.

FIRE_STREAM.basis: Same type/category, BURN_HIT with burn puff, power 90 vs 95 (delta 5); closest burn script to 90 (HEAT_WAVE 100, LAVA_PLUME 80).

INFERNO_WAVE.basis: Same type/category, BURN_HIT with burn puff, accuracy 85 matches game accuracy 85 exactly (HEAT_WAVE is 90). Power 110 vs 120 (delta 10); note: script adds power>=120 camera shake to a 110-power game move.

FIRE_PUNCH_MOVE.basis: Name normalization (game key carries a _MOVE suffix; display name is 'Fire Punch'). Same type/category, exact power 75, BURN_HIT, physical_contact lunge.

PETAL_BARRAGE.basis: Same type/category, family damage, exact power 80, special_projectile (all Grass Special projectiles use the seed particle in Layer 1). Script effect LOWER_SP_DEF_HIT is provenance only: damage-family steps have no stat beat, so no effect is misrepresented.

SOLAR_BLAST.basis: Same type/category, exact power 120, two_turn family: charge/unleash timing matches game CHARGE_TURN. Solar Blast = Solar Beam presentation.

VINE_LASH.basis: Same type/category, plain HIT, physical_contact lunge. Closest plain-HIT Grass Physical script (power 45 vs 35, delta 10); NEEDLE_ARM adds flinch, BULLET_SEED is multi-hit, SEED_BOMB is 80.

SPARK_SHOT.basis: Same type/category, exact power 40, PARALYZE_HIT with paralysis puff matching game PARALYSIS 10%, spark projectile.

THUNDER_BOLT.basis: Name normalization (game key THUNDER_BOLT, display name 'Thunderbolt'). Same type/category, PARALYZE_HIT with paralysis puff, power 90 vs 95 (delta 5).

METAL_STRIKE.basis: Same type/category, family damage, exact power 50, physical_contact lunge. Script effect RAISE_ATTACK_HIT is provenance only (no beat in damage-family steps). GEAR_GRIND at 50 is multi_hit timing, which contradicts the game's single basic attack, so it was rejected.

FLASH_CANNON_MOVE.basis: Name normalization (game key carries a _MOVE suffix; display name is 'Flash Cannon'). Same type/category, exact power 80, LOWER_SP_DEF_HIT matching game SPDEF_DOWN1 10%, special_projectile.

EARTH_TREMOR.basis: Same type/category, exact power 100, family damage, physical ground-impact steps with no lunge (correct for a ground shake). Script effect DOUBLE_DAMAGE_DIG is provenance only. Note: Layer 1 scripts are single-target presentations, so the game's 'all adjacent foes' spread is not modelled by any script; this routes the shake/impact presentation only.

MUD_BLAST.basis: Same type/category, family damage, ground-impact steps with no lunge, power 55 vs 60 (delta 5, closest single-hit Ground Physical script). No Ground Physical script carries an accuracy-down effect (MUD_SLAP/MUD_BOMB are Special category, so category bars them); accuracy-down has no Layer-1 beat in any damage-family script, so the ground-impact presentation misrepresents nothing.

SHADOW_PULSE.basis: Same type/category, exact power 80, family damage, ghost-particle projectile. No Ghost Special script carries a flinch effect; flinch in Layer 1 is a setarg flag only (see DARK_PULSE), not a visual beat, so no presentation is lost or invented. Script effect LOWER_SP_DEF_HIT is provenance only.

DARK_PULSE_MOVE.basis: Name normalization (game key carries a _MOVE suffix; display name is 'Dark Pulse'). Same type/category, exact power 80, FLINCH_HIT matching game FLINCH 20%, special_projectile.

NIGHT_SLASH_MOVE.basis: Name normalization (game key carries a _MOVE suffix; display name is 'Night Slash'). Same type/category, exact power 70, HIGH_CRITICAL matching game HIGH_CRIT, physical.

GUST_WAVE.basis: Same type/category, exact power 40, family damage, gust-particle projectile. Script effect DOUBLE_DAMAGE_FLY_OR_BOUNCE is provenance only (no extra beat).

WING_ASSAULT.basis: Same type/category, plain HIT, physical_contact lunge, power 85 vs 80 (delta 5, closest plain-HIT Flying Physical script; WING_ATTACK is 60, BOUNCE/FLY are two_turn timing).

BODY_SLAM_MOVE.basis: Name normalization (game key carries a _MOVE suffix; display name is 'Body Slam'). Same type/category, exact power 85, PARALYZE_HIT matching game PARALYSIS 30%, physical_contact lunge.

MIND_BLAST.basis: Same type/category, exact power 90, LOWER_SP_DEF_HIT matching game SPDEF_DOWN1 10%, special_projectile.

POWER_STRIKE.basis: Same type/category, exact power 85, family damage, physical_contact lunge. Script effect HIT_FLY is provenance only (no extra beat); SUBMISSION adds recoil the game move does not have, BRICK_BREAK is screen-removal.

SWARM_STRIKE.basis: Same type/category, multi_hit family with multi-hit beat steps matching game MULTI_HIT 2-5 timing, exact power 25. Script effect POISON_MULTI_HIT is provenance only: multi_hit steps contain no poison/status beat. PIN_MISSILE is the plain-MULTI_HIT alternative at power 14 (delta 11) and accuracy 85 vs game 95; TWINEEDLE accuracy 100 is closer.

IRON_BARRAGE.basis: Same type/category, multi_hit family with multi-hit beat steps matching game MULTI_HIT 2-5 timing (description 'Fires 2-5 iron shards'). Power 35 vs 50 (delta 15, the fit bound). Script effect HIT_TWICE is provenance only: multi_hit steps are repeated beats with no extra status beat. Mars decision 2026-10-26 resolved the effect/description conflict in favour of multi-hit (effect -> MULTI_HIT); METAL_CLAW (single-hit) no longer matches the corrected effect.
